name: Venom to the Undercity
summary: Apothecary Lydon sends spider god venom to the Undercity. Its strength delights Lydon, who entrusts you with a parcel for Faranell, a superior at the Apothecarium.

sections.title: A Potent Find
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon has killed nearly two dozen rabbits with one dose of the venom. Some were tiny, so their resistance was surely low. Even so, the poison is powerful. Lydon is certain Faranell will want to test it personally, and gives you a parcel for the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

faq.q: Who is sending the parcel to the Undercity?
aliases: who gives venom to the undercity
quest giver venom to the undercity
who starts venom to the undercity
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon sends the parcel after testing venom taken from the Witherbark's spider god.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the venom in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell, Lydon's superior, is to receive the venom at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

faq.q: How potent was the venom during testing?
faq.answer: One dose killed nearly two dozen rabbits, though some were very young and tiny.

aliases: previous quest venom to the undercity
faq.answer: The delivery follows Summoning Shadra, when the venom was taken from the spider god.
